feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 July 2026 9:59pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 25 July 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and low pressure near Norway as a waving frontal zone affects the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, quickly becoming west or southwest 4 or 5, veering west 5 or 6 overnight, decreasing 4 at times later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle soon becoming isolated. Isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers and occasionally poor at first in drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, backing southwest 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then occasional rain or drizzle arriving from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers and poor in drizzle.
